author: Andrew Gamble
title: Jake Paul wanted to 'go kill people' in chilling confession before Anthony Joshua bout - NewsBreak
text:
By Andrew Gamble ,
27 minutes ago Jake Paul has revealed a disturbing glimpse into his mindset, confessing he once aspired to become a Navy SEAL so he could "go kill people" during his younger years.
This Friday, the social media star-turned-boxer Paul squares off against former two-time heavyweight world champion Anthony Joshua in a Netflix -streamed showdown. The sanctioned matchup marks the British fighter's return to action since his September 2024 defeat to Daniel Dubois, where he surrendered the IBF heavyweight crown.
The announcement of Paul facing Joshua, who replaced Gervonta "Tank" Davis just weeks ago, sent shockwaves through the boxing community and immediately became one of the sport's most captivating storylines. Despite Joshua being heavily favored due to his superior size, pedigree, and skill set, Paul remains unfazed by the challenge ahead .

• Anthony Joshua hails himself as 'boxing savior' before Jake Paul made outlandish claim
Since his professional boxing debut in January 2020, Paul has compiled an impressive 12-1 record, securing victories over high-profile opponents including Mike Tyson , Anderson Silva and Tyron Woodley.
The controversial fighter has built his reputation on accepting daunting challenges, constructing a career foundation rooted in fearlessness.
When questioned about the source of his fearless approach, Paul candidly told media: "You know, that's a good question. I think I just don't give a f---."
